audit.why: 53.07% over 716 games; Gangplank owns levels 1-5, level 6 is skill, and Kassadin takes over on scaling. Difficulty 4/10 fits.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Gangplank wins the 2+ item stage, but the packet chart and the content text both say Kassadin scales past him.
audit.why: Riftwalk rank 3 is a 2-second cooldown; with items he blinks through the keg zone faster than kegs arm.
audit.corrected: win[6] and phases[6].side flipped to Kassadin, phases[6].rating to 4/10, phases[6].why rebuilt around the 2s Riftwalk.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability errors repeated across the page: (a) 'Parrrley out-ranges his point-and-click Q' — Parrrley is 625, Null Sphere is 650, so Kassadin wins that gap; (b) the text claims Null Sphere silences and locks Gangplank out of W and E. Riot's description says it interrupts channels, not that it silences.
audit.why: The range claim tells the player to step into the exact range Kassadin wins. The silence claim invents a lockout that the kit text does not support, and it drove the 'pre-cleanse with W' advice.
audit.corrected: whys[0], whys[2], spikes[0].text and early rewritten: Powder Keg at 1000 is the tool that out-ranges Null Sphere; the magic shield is dead against physical Parrrley; Nether Blade (W) is an auto-reset wind-up tell.

audit.why: Null Sphere is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s and 60-80 mana — the real punish window pre-6, and the page already trades around Riftwalk correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nether Blade (W) auto-attack reset was never mentioned.
audit.why: His burst opens with a reset auto, so the wind-up is the tell, not a spell cast.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Kassadin carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, Riftwalk's cooldown drops to 2s and he blinks straight through your kegs. Carry threat 9.5/10 — close before this.

edits.before: Kassadin is one of the weakest level-1 champions in the game while Gangplank out-ranges his short Null Sphere with Parrrley, so free-hit him off every last-hit.
edits.after: Kassadin is one of the weakest level-1 champions alive, but Null Sphere reaches 650 to Parrrley's 625 — punish him as he walks up, not by standing in his Q range.

edits.before: Your Parrrley out-ranges his point-and-click Q and he can't punish the chip, so keep his low HP bar bleeding while your kegs are setting up.
edits.after: Null Sphere out-ranges Parrrley by 25 units, so chip from a Powder Keg at 1000 instead and keep his low HP bar bleeding while kegs set up.

edits.before: Kassadin is one of the weakest early laners alive: no Riftwalk, short-range Null Sphere (Q) as his only poke, and he has to walk into Parrrley range to last-hit. Free-hit him with Q every time he steps up.
edits.after: Kassadin is one of the weakest early laners alive: no Riftwalk, and Null Sphere (Q) costs 60 mana on a 9s cooldown. Its 650 range beats Parrrley's 625, so poke from Powder Keg (E) range at 1000 instead.

edits.before: Kassadin is one of the worst early laners in the game and Gangplank punishes that hard. Pre-6 he has no Riftwalk to escape, his only ranged tool is a short-range, point-and-click Null Sphere (Q) that you out-range with Parrrley, and his magic-shield passive is dead weight against your physical Q. Open by free-hitting him with Parrrley every time he steps up to last-hit; his only answer is to give up CS and back off. Don't burn your full barrel setup yet, kegs are expensive and fragile this early, so just chip with Q and keep his health bleeding. Respect his Null Sphere only when he's all-in range, since the silence locks you out of casting W or E during the window.
edits.after: Kassadin is one of the worst early laners in the game and Gangplank punishes that hard. Pre-6 he has no Riftwalk to escape and Null Sphere (Q) burns 60 mana on a 9-second cooldown, so every orb he throws at a minion is nine seconds of free lane. Do not walk in assuming you out-range him: Null Sphere is 650 and Parrrley only 625 — it is Powder Keg (E) at 1000 that beats his reach, so chip from a keg rather than stepping to Q distance. The shield Null Sphere leaves absorbs magic damage only, so it is dead weight against your Q. Don't burn your full barrel setup yet, kegs are expensive and fragile this early. And his all-in opens with Nether Blade (W), an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.

edits.before: This is your window to bury him. With a second point in E and your keg chain set up, you start landing Parrrley-into-Powder-Keg, and that chip damage crushes a champion who only wants to farm passively and stack mana. At 6 his Riftwalk lets him blink out of your zone, but it doesn't let him out-trade you, he can blink away, not blink in and win. Set a keg, force him to either eat poke or burn his blink to dodge, and detonate as he repositions. Note that his Q silence stops you from casting W or E mid-trade, so pre-cleanse with W before you commit rather than relying on it after the silence lands. Keep shoving so he soaks turret aggro and falls behind the gold curve his whole gameplan depends on.
edits.after: This is your window to bury him. With a second point in E and your keg chain set up, you start landing Parrrley-into-Powder-Keg, and that chip crushes a champion who only wants to farm passively and stack mana. At 6 his Riftwalk lets him blink out of your zone, but it doesn't let him out-trade you, he can blink away, not blink in and win. Set a keg, force him to either eat poke or burn his blink to dodge, and detonate as he repositions. Force Pulse (E) charges off spells cast near him — your own Q and keg casts feed it, so expect the slow cone at 400 range whenever you have been poking, and hold Remove Scurvy for that slow rather than spending it on chip. Keep shoving so he soaks turret aggro and falls off the gold curve his gameplan depends on.

notes: Range error 'Parrrley out-ranges his point-and-click Q' appeared in three places and matches the mirror audit's finding — Parrrley 625 vs Null Sphere 650. Also removed the claimed Null Sphere silence lockout: Riot's text says it interrupts channels, with no silence, and the page was building trade advice on top of it. Level chart flipped at 2+ items to match the packet chart and the content's own scaling text.
